newsitem.title: UGANDA: Ugandan central bank details March intervention.
newsitem.headline: Ugandan central bank details March intervention.

text.p: The Ugandan shilling rose a marginal 0.8 percent in March maintinuing a steady trend seen in February with an average 1.1 percent rise, the central Bank of Uganda (BOU) said in a report on Wednesday.
The bank reported the shilling at an interbank average of 1,024.95 versus the dollar compared to 1,033.11 in February.
BOU said it intervened to buy dollars worth $5 million in the month. That compared to a net purchase of $4.9 million in February.
Money supply (M2) declined to 649.3 billion shillings from 655.4 billion shillings.

The bank said currency in circulation rose to 226.3 billion shillings in January from 221.1 billion shillings in December, while demand deposits declined 9.6 billion shillings to 220.1 billion shillings in the same period.
